// src/app/features/poc/tracker/request-tracker.component.ts import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router'; import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar'; import { CohortService } from '../../../core/services/cohort.service'; import { CohortRequest, SmeResponse } from '../../../shared/models'; @Component({ selector: 'app-request-tracker', templateUrl: './request-tracker.component.html', styleUrls: ['./request-tracker.component.scss'] }) export class RequestTrackerComponent implements OnInit { request: CohortRequest | null = null; loading = true; pipelineStages = [ { key: 'SUBMITTED', label: 'Submitted', icon: 'assignment' }, { key: 'UNDER_REVIEW', label: 'Admin Review', icon: 'manage_search' }, { key: 'APPROVED', label: 'Approved', icon: 'check_circle' }, { key: 'APPROVED', label: 'Pings Sent', icon: 'send' }, { key: 'RESPONSES', label: 'Responses', icon: 'forum' }, { key: 'CONFIRMED', label: 'Confirmed', icon: 'verified' }, ]; displayedColumns = ['num', 'name', 'pingSent', 'response', 'preferredDate', 'status', 'action']; constructor( private route: ActivatedRoute, private router: Router, private cohortService: CohortService, private snack: MatSnackBar ) {} ngOnInit(): void { const id = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')); this.loadRequest(id); } loadRequest(id: number): void { this.cohortService.getMyRequestById(id).subscribe({ next: (r) => { this.request = r; this.loading = false; }, error: () => { this.loading = false; this.snack.open('Failed to load tracker', 'Close', { duration: 3000 }); } }); } rePing(cohortId: number, smeId: number): void { this.cohortService.rePing(cohortId, smeId).subscribe({ next: () => { this.snack.open('Re-ping sent!', 'Close', { duration: 3000 }); this.loadRequest(cohortId); }, error: () => this.snack.open('Re-ping failed', 'Close', { duration: 3000 }) }); } getActiveStageIndex(status: string): number { const statusOrder = ['SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW','APPROVED','APPROVED','CONFIRMED']; const idx = statusOrder.indexOf(status); return idx >= 0 ? idx : 0; } getResponseStatusColor(s: string): string { const m: Record = { ACCEPTED: '#1A8240', DECLINED: '#C22626', PENDING: '#BE780E', NO_RESPONSE: '#5C728C' }; return m[s] ?? '#5C728C'; } getResponseIcon(s: string): string { return { ACCEPTED: 'check_circle', DECLINED: 'cancel', PENDING: 'hourglass_empty', NO_RESPONSE: 'help_outline' }[s] ?? 'help_outline'; } goBack(): void { this.router.navigate(['/poc/cohorts']); } }
